meta.description: Email delivery performance baselines. These values represent the expected performance of the email delivery pipeline from submission through queue processing to outbound SMTP delivery. Measured on a dedicated staging environment.
meta.environment: hetzner-cx42 (4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM) — dedicated staging
meta.source: load-tests :: performance benchmarks + SMTP MTA monitoring

submission_throughput.description: Number of emails the API server can accept and enqueue per second. Limited by payload validation, spam scanning, and queue write throughput.

queue_processing_throughput.description: Number of emails the worker service can dequeue, process (render template, check bounce, apply rate limits), and forward to the outbound MTA per second.

delivery_time_p50.description: Median time from email submission (API accept) to successful SMTP delivery acknowledgment. Includes queue wait time, template rendering, and MTA handoff.

delivery_time_p95.description: 95th percentile time from email submission to SMTP delivery acknowledgment.

delivery_time_p99.description: 99th percentile time from email submission to SMTP delivery acknowledgment.

bounce_processing_time.description: Time from bounce notification receipt to bounce event recorded in the database and suppression list updated.
